description.text: In near-total darkness, the front of

inches forward, its carbon-fibre nose and grille gradually catching a narrow band of light. The surrounding space stays almost black; only a thin highlight travels along the edge of the hood and across the low front splitter. The car advances slowly and evenly, with the engine idling low and the tyres creeping faintly over a smooth floor. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed, tightening on the emerging nose while most of the body remains hidden in shadow. The main change is the front end crossing from blackness into the first visible strip of illumination.

The low engine rumble steadies and the tyres roll audibly across the smooth surface. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed, revealing more of the surrounding space while the car continues its slow, straight advance. The change is a full reveal: the vehicle moves completely clear of the dark and becomes clearly visible in the lit space, with highlights sliding along the bodywork and the floor.
